plan.notes: UTK 2025-2026 undergraduate catalog, Computer Science Major (B.S.), Tickle College of Engineering. Catalog publishes a total of 121-123 hours; choice slots are transcribed at the first-listed option (MATH 132 at 3 credits; BIOL 101 at 4 credits), giving 122. The catalog site renders a stale archived-catalog header label on this program page; the sequence content matches the current Volunteer Core curriculum (Global Citizenship, Expanded Perspectives, Engaged Inquiries). CS upper-division electives: any 3000/4000-level COSC or approved CS-related courses (seven suggested tracks in catalog); COSC 493/494 allowed; up to three COSC 5XX or ECE 5XX courses may count; COSC 422 does not count. Engaged Inquiries: minimum 9 hours in at least two subject areas. Footnote 1: entering students with significant programming experience may proficiency-exam out of COSC 101.
